classes.generic_type: type generic or missing ("Document", a bare "Letter" or "Notice")
classes.person: a person named instead of the organization
classes.relation_missing: the joining word missing, the party not the issuer ("Type - Addressee")
classes.customer: an invoice's customer named instead of its issuer, or no issuer
classes.case_sides: a court filing's sides not as its caption and body give them
classes.event_date: a date the document mentions, not its own
classes.other_document: type names another document or a wrong kind
classes.other_party: a party the document only mentions, or a label read as a name
classes.ocr: OCR: a misread name or a hand it cannot read
classes.unreadable: the file could not be opened (TIFF with FillOrder 2)

states.after: with #51's rules, which no document of this set informed
states.followup: with #51 and the one follow-up this set showed (a reply's unconfirmed customer role no longer counts in the header-issuer rule); in-sample for this set
